name: motif-for-claude-science
description: Open exact DNA, RNA, and protein records in an interactive molecular-biology workbench or portable HTML artifact.

interface.longDescription: Open supplied FASTA, GenBank, raw DNA, RNA, protein, or Motif JSON in an interactive molecular-biology workbench. Inspect exact records and supported annotations together, or return a self-contained HTML workbench when embedded UI is unavailable. Motif does not retrieve missing records, compute alignments, validate experiments, write files, or modify remote systems.
defaultPrompt: Open this FASTA record in Motif so I can inspect its sequence, annotations, and translations.
Open these supplied DNA and protein records together in Motif so I can review them in one workbench.
Create a portable Motif HTML workbench for these records so I can share the exact sequences and annotations.
